framework: SFDA MDS-G010 Guidance on AI and ML technologies based Medical Devices (v1.0, 29/11/2022)
requirement_paraphrase: For MDMA the manufacturer is expected to provide technical documentation including product verification and validation; documentation should show verification against design specifications, validation that the device performs as intended, a usability study, and validation of safe performance under normal and reasonably foreseeable abnormal conditions.
what_is_tested: Design conformance, intended performance, usability, behaviour under abnormal inputs

framework: SDAIA AI Service Provider Accreditation (National Data Governance Platform service)
requirement_paraphrase: AI software and service providers register, appoint an AI officer, and complete a per-product questionnaire with supporting files on adherence to AI ethics standards; after committee review the product receives an incentive label and the provider an accreditation certificate.
what_is_tested: Product-level adherence to AI ethics standards (questionnaire and files)
who_tests: Review committee (not further identified on the service page; platform operated by SDAIA) reviewing the provider's questionnaire and supporting files

framework: DoH Abu Dhabi Responsible AI Risk Management Protocol (ref. as extracted DoH/Protocol/DDGO/RALRM/V1/2025, V1, published and effective Oct 2025, revision Oct 2028)
clause_or_page: Step 10 (10.1, 10.2) Reassessment, printed p.8; Step 11 (11.1, 11.2) Review and Consultation, printed pp.8-9; KPI table p.11
requirement_paraphrase: Risk assessment reviews shall be conducted at planned intervals and should also be carried out ad hoc when significant changes occur; regular assessments shall confirm that controls are implemented and effective, and corrective actions shall be verified. When reporting to DoH, organisations must give clear, accurate and timely documentation of risk assessments, controls, incidents and corrective actions; regular reporting may include audit findings. DoH review of high-risk AI systems may include compliance audits, and DoH reviews the risk register. KPIs include an annual AI ethical incident rate threshold below 15%.
what_is_tested: Continued validity of risk ratings and effectiveness of controls for deployed AI
who_tests: Product owner / risk owner in DoH units and licensed Abu Dhabi healthcare entities; DoH (DDGO) reviews

framework: DoH Abu Dhabi Responsible AI Standard V1 (Oct 2025)
requirement_paraphrase: Safety testing and failure mode analyses must be done before deployment and monitored continuously for anomalies.

framework: DoH Abu Dhabi Responsible AI Standard V1 (Oct 2025)
requirement_paraphrase: AI models must be rigorously validated against established performance benchmarks before deployment.
what_is_tested: Model performance against benchmarks and reliability criteria
who_tests: Licensed healthcare entity / developer (validation); DoH may audit

framework: DoH Abu Dhabi Responsible AI Risk Management Protocol (ref. as extracted DoH/Protocol/DDGO/RALRM/V1/2025, V1, published and effective Oct 2025, revision Oct 2028)
clause_or_page: s3 Recommended Protocol, Risk Evaluation and Treatment, Step 4 'Control Identification', printed p.6
requirement_paraphrase: Risk controls for AI systems are identified through review of safeguards, gap analysis and stakeholder consultation, and are tested through simulations or pilot studies before full implementation to confirm they reduce risk and support AI safety and reliability.
what_is_tested: Effectiveness of risk controls for an AI use case
who_tests: Product owner / risk owner in DoH units and licensed Abu Dhabi healthcare entities; DoH (DDGO) reviews

framework: DoH Abu Dhabi Responsible AI Standard V1 (Oct 2025)
requirement_paraphrase: Data scientists are to test AI systems to assess risks, confirm intended performance and compliance with healthcare and safety regulations, assess robustness, fairness and accuracy, and document metrics and logs; data users identify groups at risk of disparate outcomes and report use of relevant attributes.
who_tests: Data scientists (data users for the group and attribute duties)

framework: SDAIA AI Ethics Principles (Version 1.0, September 2023, read on dgp.sdaia.gov.sa; the 2025 edition on sdaia.gov.sa was not readable)
clause_or_page: Roles and Responsibilities: AI System Assessor (pp. 7, 31); Responsible AI Officer (p. 31); SDAIA tasks (p. 29)
requirement_paraphrase: Defines an AI System Assessor role that audits AI systems; publishing audit reports on an organisation's AI ethics assessment is a Responsible AI Officer task; SDAIA measures compliance of adopting entities and may audit AI ethics activities.
what_is_tested: Entity AI-ethics process and documentation; AI development and procurement process
who_tests: AI System Assessor; SDAIA with National Regulatory Authorities

framework: Canada - Directive on Automated Decision-Making (TBS, amended 2025-06-24)
requirement_paraphrase: Document client feedback, unexpected impacts, human overrides and other system failures; use findings from outcome monitoring and this documentation to identify issues and take corrective action.
what_is_tested: Operational failure/override/feedback logging and corrective action

framework: Canada - Directive on Automated Decision-Making (TBS, amended 2025-06-24)
